patterns.note: A dense, full-bleed masonry grid of images dominates the page, with minimal gutters between items, creating an immersive visual experience.
The site uses a stark white background to make the extremely vibrant, high-contrast colors within the photographic content pop, creating a dynamic and energetic feel.
The 'JUCO' logo and 'MENU' text remain sticky in the top corners of the viewport as the dense image grid scrolls vertically underneath, providing persistent navigation and branding.

technique_notes: The primary content area is built as a responsive masonry grid, where images of varying aspect ratios are packed tightly together with minimal spacing, filling the entire width of the browser window.

The header elements, consisting of a logo and a menu trigger, are positioned absolutely and fixed to the top corners of the viewport, ensuring they remain visible and accessible as the user scrolls through the extensive image content.
Scroll-triggered motion is limited to the sticky header; the main content area simply scrolls into view without additional animations like fade-ins or parallax effects.

design_tokens.type_scale: Two distinct uppercase sans-serif sizes for header elements, with the brand name significantly larger than the menu trigger.
design_tokens.spacing: dense — images are packed tightly with minimal gutters, creating an overwhelming visual density.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its unapologetic, full-bleed, and extremely dense masonry grid of vibrant, high-impact photography. It prioritizes a visual feast above all else, creating an immediate and overwhelming impression of creative energy and diversity.
